evals.name: ep01-silicon-trap-full
evals.prompt: Draft a production script for EP01 — The Silicon Trap. Use the research brief at /episodes/EP01-silicon-trap/brief.md and the angle memo at /skills/script-draft/test-fixtures/ep01-angle-memo.md. Follow the script-draft skill instructions. The episode should be ~18 minutes (2,700 words), 5 beats, in the two-column production format.
evals.expected_output: A complete two-column production script with: 5 beats organized by tension not logic, decoder posture throughout, stakes in first 30 seconds, claim verification tags, visual motif (supply chain web) evolving across beats, 2-3 visual-first moments, mode balance within targets, asset summary tables. Quality comparable to the existing EP01 v4 script.
